title: Finite local stage lifts of a section of an etale sheaf colimit
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative ring. Let I be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], G : I → Sh(X_et, Mod_Λ) a diagram of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and c a colimit cocone with vertex H. Let U be an object of X_et whose underlying scheme is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let t ∈ H(U). There exist a finite index type B, a covering family f_b : V_b → U in X_et, with each underlying scheme of V_b ×_U V_b′ quasi-compact, a single object i ∈ I and sections s_b ∈ G_i(V_b) such that (c_i)_{V_b}(s_b) = t|_{V_b} for every b. The index type may be empty; no compatibility of the s_b on overlaps is claimed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-module-sheaf-colimit-local-representatives] to obtain a covering sieve S of arrows on which t comes from a stage. This proved local-image subsheaf argument works in the independent universes of this statement without assuming the existence of a presheaf sheafification.

Present S by the family indexed by S.arrows.category (Mathlib Sieve.ofArrows_category). The small-etale covering criterion gives joint surjectivity on U.left. The arrows are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation], realized by the Mathlib instance on underlying arrows. Form the scheme etale cover C, use QuasiCompactCover.of_isOpenMap and QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom to obtain a finite affine refinement D and its factorization k. Compose D.f with U.hom to make X-etale objects, and reindex by ULift of Fin in universe u. The refinement factorization and downward closure ensure all resulting arrows still lie in S.

The affine sources of D are quasi-compact. Since U.left is quasi-separated, Mathlib quasi-compactness and pullback instances make the scheme pullbacks of D.f quasi-compact. The composite Scheme.Etale.forget X followed by Over.forget X preserves pullbacks. PreservesPullback.iso identifies each intrinsic etale pullback with the corresponding scheme pullback, and the inverse scheme-isomorphism homeomorphism transfers CompactSpace.

Choose a stage j_b and representative x_b for each refined covering arrow from S. Apply IsFiltered.sup_objs_exists to the finite image of b ↦ j_b, including the empty image. Choose arrows j_b → i and transport x_b using G. Applying the colimit cocone equation c.w to x_b shows that the images of these transported sections are still the restrictions of t.

lean.statement: theorem etale_section_colimit_local_lifts (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] (U : X.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left] (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (G : I ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{max v w} Λ)) (c : Cocone G) (hc : IsColimit c) (t : c.pt.obj.obj (op U)) : ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : Finite B) (V : B → X.Etale) (f : ∀ b, V b ⟶ U), Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology U ∧ (∀ b b', CompactSpace (pullback (f b) (f b')).left) ∧ ∃ (i : I) (s : ∀ b, (G.obj i).obj.obj (op (V b))), ∀ b, ((c.ι.app i).hom.app (op (V b))).hom (s b) = (c.pt.obj.map (f b).op).hom t
